name: flashcards_export
description:
Convert CSV flashcards (front, back, tags, optional deck and extra fields) into an Anki-importable tab-separated text file with the file headers of the Anki manual (#separator:Tab, #html, #notetype, #deck, #tags, #columns, #tags column, #deck column), quoting fields that hold tabs, newlines or quotes as Anki expects, or turning newlines into
in HTML mode.

header.description: auto: the first row is a header when one of its cells is 'front'

columns.description: Column names when there is no header row

newlines.description: Default br with html, else quote

output.tsv:
#separator:Tab
#html:false
#columns:Front	Back	Tags
#tags column:3
bonjour	hello	french greetings

catalog.source: Anki Manual, Importing > Text Files > File Headers and escaping (https://docs.ankiweb.net/importing/text-files.html), Anki 2.1.54+
